order_ref: TNERC Tariff Order T.P. No. 1 of 2023 as amended for FY 2025-26; ToD windows per Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Amendment Rules 2023
notes: Rates hand-encoded from the published order and rounded to the paisa. Peak multiplier 1.25 and solar 0.80 satisfy the statutory floor of >=1.2x peak and <=0.8x solar for commercial and industrial consumers. Billing demand is the highest 30-minute kVA block of the month, floored at 90% of contract demand. VERIFY AGAINST THE CURRENT ORDER BEFORE QUOTING COMMERCIALLY.
